named_subject: a light bulb with a filament line and a threaded screw base
action: The light bulb shrinks and moves down and slightly left in frame as the view pulls back, then holds still in the lower middle of the frame.
identity_gap: The animated bulb uses the same lopsided round outline, single filament stroke, short neck lines and three pointed base bands as the doodle, so it reads as the same drawing.
notes: The bulb's scale and position follow the film's pull-back, but between frames 4 and 5 the bulb drops and shrinks in one step and the grey shelf scenery changes at once, and at frame 9 the grey vase shape switches outline. Spreading the 4-to-5 change over more frames and keeping the grey scenery outlines constant would help most.
